title: Tradable Discs
description: This mod adds tradable discs from Wandering Traders.
body:
![TradableDiscs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20b53734d2b233f55834078485d033e8c78932a0.png)

Do you want to find a way to obtain discs much easily without having to get a Skeleton to kill a Creeper?

You can with this, a mod that adds discs to a Wandering Trader's list of trades.

You can trade Emeralds for this list of discs currently in the mod:
- Cat
- Chirp
- Blocks
- 11
- Strad
- Ward
- Far

(1.0.1)
- Wait
- Stal

![A list of trades.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f7bb9705b907f9227c165f1dbb0d1c466083d58.png)
